title: How AI is Transforming Property Management in 2025
summary: The property management industry is undergoing one of its most significant evolutions in decades. At the heart of this change is artificial intelligence (AI). In 2025, AI is no longer just a buzzword — it's a core component of how property managers operate, scale, and provide value.
